sources.quote: The previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp have been retired

unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): not listed on Scale's table read for 2026-10-03 (no DeepSeek entry)
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: the page embeds runs for this model, but the scores are not readable as text
METR 50% time horizon: no DeepSeek V4 model listed on the page's update log; the graph did not render in the page text
retires: 2026-09-10 is the day DeepSeek's change log calls V4-Flash retired from the API (the V4.1-Flash release); no earlier notice was found

pricing_usd_per_mtok: no DeepSeek page read lists a price for the retired id; the figures are Artificial Analysis's, with no peak or off-peak split stated; Artificial Analysis states a 97% cache discount but no cached-input price
context_window: the maker says 1M; whether that is 1,000,000 or 1,048,576 tokens is not stated (the card uses 1,000,000, as Artificial Analysis lists it)

max_output: DeepSeek's current pricing page gives 384K for the current ids and the model card recommends 384K for high and max; 393,216 is that figure in tokens, and no page gives a V4-Flash-only limit

parameters: DeepSeek and Artificial Analysis say 284B total and 13B active; Hugging Face's API counts about 304B parameters in the 0731 weight files, and no page explains the gap (the attached speculative-decoding module may account for part, inferred)
system_card: DeepSeek publishes no system card; the linked V4 Preview technical report has no safety or alignment section and describes the Preview, not the 0731 post-training

reasoning default: the weights' reference encoding defaults reasoning_effort to low (no prefix); DeepSeek's API guide gives high as the API default, but it now describes the current ids and this model is no longer served there
prompting_guides: DeepSeek publishes no prompt-writing guide; the listed pages are the prompt-format reference and API usage guides, which now describe the current ids
